authorization.verbatim: User-authorized Relic Remover motif replacement; same bounded mechanical native Small/Outline export.

method: Preserve originals/BigIcons. Small variant changes alpha only for neutral dark pixels (maxRGB<=64, chroma<=20) inside at most2%short-edge band AND connected through dark pixels to external transparency. Colored planes are barriers; disconnected inner dark edges remain unchanged. Separate white outline uses original alpha; native NRelic applies black50%. No resizing/repainting or interior-RGBA changes.
limits: Import processing is separate; no raw PNG-to-CTEX identity claim.
Static preview is not native live UI acceptance.
